opus-low-1.summary: PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN is put into the query string without URL encoding. A token that contains +, & or = breaks the Document API URL, so the uid lookup fails. (These line numbers are from the combined diff output, not the after file; I did not map them.)

uploadHtmlAttachment does not check that AIRTABLE_PAT and AIRTABLE_BASE_ID are set. When either is missing, it posts to a URL containing 'undefined' or with 'Bearer undefined', and this happens only after the draft record is already created, which leaves a draft with no HTML. (These line numbers are from the combined diff output, not the after file.)
site.name goes into join(workdir, name) unchecked. A name containing '/' or '..' clones outside workdir or into a nested path, and a name with spaces may not match the repo.

opus-medium-1.summary: branchTip treats only 'HTTP 404' as 'branch gone', but GET repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} for a ref that does not exist answers 422 ('No commit found for SHA'), so a dashboard naming a deleted branch makes branchTip throw instead of returning null, failing the whole blocked-branch check.

lookupDocIds keys the uid-to-id map by uid alone, but Prismic uids are unique only per custom type; when two types share a uid (e.g. page 'about' and post 'about'), the last one wins and the update path PUTs one document's body onto the other type's document id, overwriting or corrupting the wrong document.

site.repoUrl goes to `git clone` with no `--` separator, so a value starting with '-' (e.g. '--upload-pack=...') is read as an option and can run commands. site.name also goes into join(workdir, name) without checks, so a name like '../x' or one containing '/' clones or reuses a directory outside workdir.

Any non-empty directory already at workdir/<name> is returned as the site's checkout without checking that it is a clone of site.repoUrl, so two sites that share a name, or a stray directory, get audited as the wrong repository.

The Airtable draft row is created before the HTML upload, and AIRTABLE_PAT and AIRTABLE_BASE_ID are never checked. When either is unset (the URL holds 'undefined', the header says 'Bearer undefined') or the upload fails, the function throws after createDraft, leaving an orphan draft row with no rendered HTML that a retry will duplicate.

A rich-text signature with more than one paragraph is joined with a space, so a sign-off like 'Warmly,' / 'The Pointe Team' reaches the visitor's email as one line, 'Warmly, The Pointe Team', instead of keeping its line breaks.
An authored end_time that is before or equal to start_time is used as given, producing a calendar invite that ends before it starts, instead of falling back to the default duration.
foundOnPage1 is computed from the raw average but position is rounded, so an average of 10.4 reports position 10 with foundOnPage1=false, which contradicts itself in the report.
The `existing` filename map is not updated after an upload, so two plan assets with the same filename (the same image referenced twice) are both uploaded, creating duplicate library assets.

sonnet-medium-1.summary: lookupDocIds keys the map by uid alone. Prismic uids are unique per custom type, not globally. If two types share a uid (e.g. 'home'), the later one overwrites the earlier, so the PUT fallback at line 208 can update the wrong document.

The clone target is join(workdir, site.name) with no sanitisation, so a name like '../x' clones outside workdir. Separately, `git clone <repoUrl>` has no `--` separator, so a repoUrl starting with '-' is parsed as a git option.

With `gh api --paginate --jq`, the jq filter runs once per page and the outputs are joined by plain newlines, not the '# ---' separator. Dashboards on different pages are concatenated with no section boundary, so a trailing blocked section on one page can bleed into the next dashboard's preamble.

opus-xhigh-2.summary: branchTip treats only an HTTP 404 as 'branch gone', but GitHub's GET repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} answers a ref that does not exist with 422 ('No commit found for SHA: <ref>'). When a dashboard names a branch that has been deleted, which the contract says is an expected case, branchTip throws instead of returning null, and the repo's blocked-branch audit fails.

lookupDocIds keys the uid-to-id map by uid alone, but Prismic uids are unique only per custom type (and per language). When two types share a uid (e.g. page/home and landing/home), map.get(doc.uid) can return the other type's document, and the PUT at lines 220-227 overwrites that document with this doc's data, or fails.

deriveNameFromRepoUrl returns an empty string for a repoUrl with a trailing slash (e.g. 'https://github.com/org/repo/'), so target becomes the workdir itself. If the workdir already holds other clones, the site is returned with path = workdir and the whole workdir is audited; if it is empty, the repo is cloned straight into it. The same happens when site.name is an empty string, because ?? does not fall back on ''.
repoUrl is passed to git clone with no '--' separator. A repoUrl that starts with '-' (e.g. '--upload-pack=<cmd>') is read as an option and can run an arbitrary command.

foundOnPage1 is decided on the raw average but position is rounded. For an average between 10 and 10.5 (e.g. 10.3) the result is position 10 with foundOnPage1 false, which contradicts itself in the report.

derivePeriodStart reads Airtable (listReportsForSite) whenever base is non-null, before the previewOnly branch, even though periodStart is never used in a preview. That breaks the documented 'previewOnly: never touch Airtable' contract, and a preview fails on Airtable errors or bad credentials.

gold.summary: branchTip treats only 'HTTP 404' as 'branch gone', but GitHub's GET /repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} answers 422 ('No commit found for SHA: renovate/x') for a ref that does not exist. A dashboard that names a deleted branch therefore throws instead of returning the documented null, and that aborts the blocked-branch check for the whole repo.

With --paginate, gh runs the --jq filter on each page separately, so the join('\n# ---\n') separator only goes between dashboards on the same page. If a repo has two open dashboards on different pages, they are joined by a bare newline, so the first body's last section (possibly the blocked section) runs on into the second body until its first ## heading.

The checkout directory name is taken from site.name as-is, or from the last URL segment. A name with '/' or '..' (or a display name with spaces) lands outside workdir or in an odd directory. A repoUrl with a trailing slash (https://github.com/org/repo/) gives an empty name, so target becomes workdir itself; when workdir already holds other clones it is non-empty and is returned as this site's path.

site.repoUrl is passed to `git clone` without a preceding `--`. A stored repoUrl that starts with '-' (e.g. '--upload-pack=<cmd>') is parsed as a git option rather than a URL: an argument-injection hole.

lookupDocIds keys its map by uid alone across every custom type, but Prismic uids are unique only within a type. When the target repo holds two documents of different types with the same uid (e.g. page 'about' and another type's 'about'), the 'already exists' fallback can look up the other type's id and PUT this document's body over the wrong document.

foundOnPage1 tests the unrounded average while position is rounded. An average of 10.4 reports position 10 but foundOnPage1=false, so the report shows a page-1 position that is flagged as not on page 1.

With previewOnly=true and a non-null base, derivePeriodStart still calls listReportsForSite against Airtable. That breaks the documented 'render locally only, never touch Airtable' contract, and an Airtable outage fails a pure local preview whose rendered HTML never uses periodStart.

The draft row is created before the HTML upload. If uploadHtmlAttachment throws (bad PAT, missing AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, network error), an orphan draft with no attachment that is never marked ready stays in Airtable, and a retry creates a duplicate row with the same reportId.

A multi-paragraph signature is joined with a space, so a rich-text signature such as 'Warmly,' / 'The Flower Court team' becomes one line ('Warmly, The Flower Court team') in the plain-text email, losing its line breaks.

sonnet-medium-2.summary: git clone is passed site.repoUrl with no `--` separator, so a repoUrl starting with `-` is parsed as a git option. The target directory is also built from an unvalidated site.name or URL basename.

foundOnPage1 compares the raw average position to 10, but position is rounded. An average of 10.4 gives foundOnPage1=false with position 10, and 9.6 gives position 10. The flag and the number can disagree.

sonnet-high-1.summary: lookupDocIds keys the uid-to-id map by uid alone, and the lookup at line 208 uses doc.uid alone. Prismic uids are unique only per type and language. If two published documents of different types share a uid (e.g. a page and a landing doc both 'home'), the later one overwrites the earlier in the map. The PUT fallback then updates the wrong document, overwriting its data with a body of a different type. The map should be keyed on type plus uid.

deriveNameFromRepoUrl returns an empty string for a repoUrl with a trailing slash (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo/), and `??` does not catch ''. The target then becomes workdir itself. A non-empty workdir is treated as an existing checkout, so the site's path is set to the whole workdir and audits run on the wrong tree. Otherwise git clone targets the workdir directly.

previewOnly is documented as 'render locally only, never touch Airtable', but periodStart is derived before the previewOnly check. When a non-null base is passed with previewOnly, derivePeriodStart calls listReportsForSite and reads Airtable. The preview then needs credentials and network, and can fail on an Airtable error.

sonnet-high-2.summary: The clone directory name comes from `site.name`, or from the last URL segment, and is joined onto `workdir` unsanitised. A name like `../../x` puts the target outside `workdir`. A repoUrl with a trailing slash makes the derived name empty, so `target === workdir`. A non-empty workdir is then returned as the site path without any clone. An empty `site.name` is not caught by `??`.

`git clone site.repoUrl target` has no `--` separator. A repoUrl beginning with `-`, for example `--upload-pack=<cmd>`, is parsed by git as an option, which allows argument injection and command execution. The URL comes from fleet or site data.
Any non-empty directory at the target path is accepted as the site's checkout, with no check that it is a git repo for this repoUrl. A stale or unrelated directory is audited as if it were the site.

`lookupDocIds` keys the uid-to-id map on `uid` alone, but Prismic uids are only unique per custom type, and per language. When POST reports 'already exists', the PUT fallback can look up another type's document that shares the uid (for example `home` or `about`). It then overwrites that wrong document with this doc's body.

`branchTip` returns null only on 'HTTP 404'. As far as I recall, GitHub answers `GET /repos/{r}/commits/{ref}` for a nonexistent ref with 422 'No commit found for SHA', not 404. If so, a deleted branch named in the dashboard throws instead of returning null, which breaks the documented contract and the blocked-branch audit. I could not confirm the status code from the input files.

`foundOnPage1` is computed from the unrounded average position, but `position` is rounded. An average of 10.4 gives `position: 10` with `foundOnPage1: false`. Consumers such as the dashboard's `searchCell` then treat a rank of 10 as not on page 1.

`previewOnly` is documented as 'never touch Airtable', but `derivePeriodStart` runs before the preview branch whenever a non-null `base` is passed. It issues `listReportsForSite` reads against Airtable, and a failure there breaks a purely local preview. The result is unused in preview mode.

The draft is rendered, uploaded and marked ready with hard-coded `gaUsersCurrent: 0` and `gaUsersPrevious: 0`. The attached report HTML therefore shows 0 users (delta 0) for every site, as if that were real GA data.

The multi-block rich-text signature is joined with a space (`join(" ")`), so a sign-off authored on separate lines ('Warmly,' / 'The team') is collapsed into one line in the plain-text email. I did not see how `parseReplyCopy` consumes `signature`, so this may be a deliberate format.

opus-xhigh-1.summary: branchTip only maps a 404 to null, but GitHub's GET /repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} answers 422 'No commit found for SHA: <ref>' when the branch name does not exist. A dashboard naming a deleted branch, which the docstring calls the normal case, makes branchTip throw instead of returning null, so the whole blocked-branch check errors for that repo.

site.repoUrl goes to `git clone` as a positional argument with no `--` separator. A repoUrl that starts with '-' (e.g. `--upload-pack=<cmd>` or `-u <cmd>`) is read as a git option, which allows command execution or a retargeted clone.

The clone target is join(workdir, site.name) with site.name unsanitised. A name containing '/' or '..' (or a repoUrl with a trailing slash, which derives an empty name and makes target the workdir itself) clones outside or onto the workdir, or reuses an unrelated non-empty directory as the site's checkout.

lookupDocIds keys document ids by uid alone (line 121) and the update path looks them up by doc.uid without the type (line 208). Prismic uids are unique only per custom type, so when two types share a uid (e.g. page 'about' and post 'about'), the 'already exists' fallback PUTs this document's body over a different document.

With previewOnly=true and a non-null base, derivePeriodStart still calls listReportsForSite against Airtable. That breaks the documented 'render locally only, never touch Airtable' contract, and the preview fails whenever Airtable is unreachable.

The Airtable draft row is created before the HTML upload. If the upload fails (for example AIRTABLE_PAT or AIRTABLE_BASE_ID is unset, giving 'Bearer undefined' or a v0/undefined URL), the row is left without its attachment and never marked ready, and every retry creates another duplicate draft row with the same reportId.

A multi-paragraph rich-text signature is joined with a space, so a signature authored as separate lines (e.g. 'Warmly,' / 'The Pointe team') reaches the plain-text confirmation email as one run-on line instead of keeping its line breaks.

foundOnPage1 tests the unrounded average (pos <= 10) while position is Math.round(pos). An average of 10.0–10.49 comes back as position 10 with foundOnPage1 false, which contradicts itself, and the report hides a result it calls position 10.

opus-low-2.summary: GitHub's GET /repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} answers 422 ("No commit found for SHA"), not 404, when the branch no longer exists. So branchTip throws on a deleted branch when it should return null, and the dashboard check fails on exactly the case the code calls normal.

The Airtable draft row is created before the HTML upload. If AIRTABLE_PAT or AIRTABLE_BASE_ID is unset (the URL then contains 'undefined') or the upload fails, the draft row is left behind with no attachment and is not marked ready. A retry then creates a duplicate.
PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN is put into the query string without URL encoding. A token containing reserved characters breaks the Document API lookup.

opus-medium-2.summary: branchTip treats only HTTP 404 as 'branch gone', but GET repos/{repo}/commits/{ref} for a deleted/nonexistent branch answers 422 'No commit found for SHA', so a dashboard naming a deleted branch makes branchTip throw instead of returning null, failing the whole check.

With --paginate, gh applies --jq to each page separately, so dashboards on different pages are concatenated with a bare newline instead of the '# ---' separator; a blocked section ending one dashboard stays open into the next dashboard's preamble, and per-page empty results add stray lines.

git clone is invoked with site.repoUrl as a positional argument without a '--' separator, so a repoUrl beginning with '-' (e.g. '--upload-pack=cmd') is parsed as an option, allowing command execution.

site.name (a display name, unvalidated) is joined into the clone target, so a name containing '/' or '..' escapes workdir; and an existing non-empty target is returned as the site's checkout without checking it is that repo, so two sites with the same name/derived name share one (wrong) checkout; a repoUrl with a trailing slash derives an empty name and returns workdir itself.

lookupDocIds keys the map by uid alone across all custom types, but Prismic uids are unique only per type; when two types share a uid (e.g. page 'about' and post 'about'), the PUT update targets whichever document was seen last, overwriting the wrong document.
PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN is interpolated into the query string without encodeURIComponent, so a token containing '+', '&' or '=' is corrupted and the Document API lookup fails.

With previewOnly=true and a non-null base, derivePeriodStart still reads Airtable (listReportsForSite), contradicting the 'never touch Airtable' contract of previewOnly and failing the preview if Airtable is unreachable.
A multi-paragraph signature (e.g. 'Warmly,' / 'The Team') is joined with a space, collapsing its line breaks into one line ('Warmly, The Team') in the plain-text email.
foundOnPage1 uses the unrounded position while position is rounded, so an average of 10.3 reports position 10 yet foundOnPage1=false, an inconsistent result in the report.
